rules.card_name: Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card

reward_rules.description: For Card Members having Amazon Prime Membership, earn rate of the Reward Points will be 5% of the transaction amount for all the transactions carried out on www.amazon.in (excluding Gold Coins via Amazon Pay).

For Card Members not having Prime Membership, earn rate of the Reward Points will be 3% of the transaction amount for all transactions carried out on www.amazon.in (excluding Gold Coins via Amazon Pay).
2% Reward Points on digitally fulfilled categories (e.g. mobile recharges, bill payments) via Login and Pay with Amazon Pay and physical gift cards.
1% Reward Points on all purchases on non-Amazon platform.

gotchas: With effect from Oct 11, 2025, education and international transactions will not be eligible for any Reward Points. Also, utility transactions outside the Amazon platform will not be eligible for any Reward Points. Source: icici_amazon_pay_tnc_2026-10.pdf p.17

Transactions for the purchase of fuel, gold, silver, any precious metal, and any tax-related payments will not be eligible for Reward Points. Rent transactions will not earn any Reward Points. Source: icici_amazon_pay_tnc_2026-10.pdf p.17

EMI transactions, including EMI on call and cash transactions, will not be eligible for Reward Points. If any transaction is converted later to EMI or EMI on call, Reward Points for that transaction will be clawed back. Source: icici_amazon_pay_tnc_2026-10.pdf p.17
Reward Points earned on all transactions will be rounded down to the nearest integer. Source: icici_amazon_pay_tnc_2026-10.pdf p.17

For any disputes against monthly cashback/rewards, the customer has to reach out to ICICI Bank within 90 days from the date of issuance. Post this period, the calculation will be assumed as accurate. Source: icici_amazon_pay_tnc_2026-10.pdf p.17-18

All Reward Points will be credited as Amazon Pay balance within 2 working days of the completion of your last billing cycle in terms of Amazon Gift Cards. Source: icici_amazon_pay_tnc_2026-10.pdf p.17-18

ICICI Bank reserves the right to revise the policies, features and benefits offered on the Card from time to time and may notify the Card Member of such revisions/changes. The Card Member will be bound by such revisions/changes unless the Card is returned for cancellation before the date on which the revisions/changes are made. Source: icici_amazon_pay_tnc_2026-10.pdf p.19
No annual fee is stated in the MITC for this card. The MITC states: 'There is no joining or annual fee for the Amazon Pay ICICI Bank Credit Card.' Source: icici_amazon_pay_mitc_2026-07.pdf p.1
Fuel transactions are also subject to surcharge waiver language, but the rewards exclusion still applies. Source: icici_amazon_pay_tnc_2026-10.pdf p.17

The fee tables in the MITC include several card-wide charges, but none are annual fee for this card; the fee row explicitly states no joining or annual fee. Source: icici_amazon_pay_mitc_2026-07.pdf p.1

## XIV. Billing

All Card Members will be billed on a monthly basis for all Charges incurred by the use of the Card and for all charges applicable to the Card Account. ICICI Bank will try that no delay is caused in dispatching the Statement to the Card Member. However, there may be no statement generated for the period in which there has been no outstanding due and no transaction on the Card Account in the preceding month. The billing statement will be dispatched on a monthly basis to customers only through e-mail to the e-mail ID as per our records.

ICICI Bank will try to provide Statement online with suitable security to ensure that the Statement can be accessed only by the Card Member. In the event of non-receipt of the Statement, for any reason whatsoever, there being no delay on the part of ICICI Bank in dispatching them, the Card Member will pay ICICI Bank the sum total of all dues calculated by using copies of the charge slips in their possession by the Payment Due Date or by enquiring with ICICI Bank Customer Care.

Over-limit status may also happen because of fees or interest charges.

Charges in foreign currency: If a transaction is made in a currency other than Indian Rupees, the transaction will be converted into Indian Rupees. The conversion will take place on the date the transaction is settled with ICICI Bank, which may not be the same date on which the transaction was made. If the transaction is not in USD, the conversion will be made through USD, by converting the charged amount into USD and then by converting USD amount into Indian Rupees.

- To ensure that Credit Card usage aligns with applicable regulatory guidelines, the Credit Card Terms and Conditions and internal policies of the Bank, the Bank may conduct periodic reviews of Credit Card usage. This includes, but is not limited to, identifying any excessive utilisation beyond the sanctioned credit limit within a single billing cycle, disproportionate usage at a few merchant establishments, use of the Card for repayment of other Credit Cards / loans, fund transfers to Savings Accounts, potential merchant collusion, usage for business or non-personal expenses and misuse of features / programmes for accumulating undue reward points, cashback or other benefits. In such cases, ICICI Bank may, at its sole discretion, cancel the concerned Credit Card(s), including any add-on Cards and withhold or cancel accrued reward points or cashback at the customer level without prior notice. ICICI Bank may also contact the Card Member via phone or other formal channels to 21 seek clarification or documentation regarding the Card usage. Failure to provide satisfactory responses may lead to Card blocking/closure.

- If the ICICI Bank Credit Card is terminated, whether voluntarily by the Primary Card Member or by the Bank, the Card Member will immediately cease to be eligible for earning reward points or cashback. All unused or unredeemed reward points or cashback shall automatically be forfeited immediately after voluntary or involuntary cancellation.
